87K likes, 803 comments - kareenakapoorkhan on October 13, 2026: "You think you know me, until you don’t!

Once upon a time, everyone wanted to fit into my juttis 👀
But here’s the thing: you’re not supposed to fit into a jutti. A jutti is supposed to fit into YOU.

And that’s exactly what I had in mind when I created my very own collection with Fizzy Goblet. ❤️

So go on, find your own jutti! ✨

Kareena Kapoor Khan x Fizzy Goblet
#KKKxFizzyGoblet

(Fizzy Goblet, Fizzy Goblet Collection, Find Your Own Jutti, Fizzy Goblet Jutti)".
